$schema_note: Conformance fixture for the botpack-affect determinism contract (SPEC §7). Normative values are the 16-char lowercase hex strings, each the exact f64::to_bits() bit pattern. Decimal strings are NON-NORMATIVE renderings for human reading only — never parse them back.

scenario.description: One AffectEngine run: construct from bit patterns, apply one stimulus, ten ticks of 1.7 s.

tick.dt_note: 1.7 is NOT exactly representable as f64; the bit pattern above is the contract.

provenance.note: The expected bit patterns were produced by an actual AffectEngine run of the Rust reference implementation (botpack-affect), not by decoding decimal literals from the README. The README decimals match these bits only as a cross-check and are not the source of truth.
